ambiguous.rationale: The case set was selected to verify unique same-species direct anchors and one outside-taxonomy case. It contains no independently established ambiguous identity. The review makes no claim about other text-channel candidates.

direct_family.rationale: Frozen primary accession and taxonomy identify the official target family in 64 historical cases. A separately confirmed supplemental primary accession identifies the existing official family for CHEMBL3580492.

direct_type.rationale: The reviewed snapshot carries family-only provider annotation. The export Type column describes family rows.

identity_conflict.rationale: No reviewed case has divergent positive same-species primary UniProt and HGNC owners. CHEMBL4471 has a legacy mixed-species row rather than two incompatible admitted exact channels.

local_vs_direct.rationale: Frozen ChEMBL EC supports a local Enzyme class in 40 rows. It agrees with 35 direct Enzyme classes. Five catalytic receptors have direct Receptor class and require review because the local class differs.

non_applicable.rationale: All frozen Silver v23 source records inspected are SINGLE PROTEIN and all 66 reviewed rows have positive taxonomy and well-formed own primary identity. No reviewed invalid_input predicate is claimed.

partial_direct.rationale: The 65 family-supported direct classifications are partial under family-only annotation.

taxonomy_boundary.rationale: CHEMBL4471 has validated taxon 9913, outside 9606, 10090 and 10116, so it remains eligible for local EC and orthology evidence.

unmatched.rationale: The valid Bos taurus case is outside authorized official species and has no admitted same-species provider ID. Its own EC supports a local class.

limitations: Case IDs must be present in the canonically imported Stage0 V2 cohort and shadow evidence with the same input identities and EC. Recheck those inputs once the actual cohort is frozen.
The official 64 direct-case expectation does not substitute for successful pipeline execution or an RF-008 receipt.
Include each case in Stage0 only when the unchanged raw ChEMBL identity, EC and proof manifest from the shadow match the reviewed source fields.
